title: Triangle inequality for local mass
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U, G ⊆ ℝ^P, X, Y, Z ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (contract GeometricCurrentOn U k) and c ∈ ℝ with |c| ≤ 1, and suppose Z(ω) = X(ω) + c·Y(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G. Then M_G(Z) ≤ M_G(X) + M_G(Y), where M_G is the SimonGMT local mass massOn (supremum in [0, ∞] of ofReal(T(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and Euclidean coefficient norm |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)) (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (c : ℝ), |c| ≤ 1 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) ⊆ G → Z ω = X ω + c * Y ω) → Z.massOn G ≤ X.massOn G + Y.massOn G
